notes.title: New mechanics in Slaps And Beans 2
notes.content:
In Slaps And Beans 2 the combat system and its progression will be enhanced and improved. This will be done through the use of new environmental interactions (especially with Terence), improved combos to create single or co-operative attacks, and the addition of new power-ups.
Here are a few examples: 


[previewyoutube=3VNAJlbi1Zg;full][/previewyoutube]
Improved Terence's dodging ability. When Terence dodges a hit near a wall or obstacle the enemy will be confused and vulnerable.


[previewyoutube=wsURVfHSEXA;full][/previewyoutube]
Terence will be able to use his speed to "lock" hordes of enemies and lead them towards Bud or a trap.


[previewyoutube=Nk4gPIS_VEs;full][/previewyoutube]
New power-ups will temporarily increase players' abilities and certain gameplay parameters (strength, speed, damage resistance, time running speed, etc.).

notes.title: UPDATE 0.93
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31415445/dfe980cd4dbb25b052edc39f5f69a99dbfd3a053.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Removed Unity launcher: now input keys and resolutions can be changed directly in game
[*] Added support for 4:3 and 16:10 aspect ratios
[*] Dune Buggy: fixed collisions on haystack
[*] Dune buggy: Added function to put the overhead machine back on track
[*] Dune buggy: Increased grip and removed some obstacles based on difficulty level
[*] Terence’s blocks are not random anymore: now they are selected by movement direction and run state.
[*] Tweaks on item throwing: increased collisions and damages
[*] Terence’s Horse[*]Jump movement is not automatic anymore. Player has to press the Block/Defense button to do it.
[*] Fixed Terence AI bug on Western level Bridge
[*] Fixed rocket bug in Lunapark boss area
[*] Added “Hit Stop” option, to enable/disable an animation pause on hits effect.
[*] Fat enemies fall animation tweaks
[*] Tweaks on thrown enemies (increased damage and forces)
[*] Second batch of backer names update in credits screen
[*] Tweaks on enemies distribution (less chaotic)
[*] Fixed entrance cutscene to the supermarket
[*] Review of Hungarian and Italian texts
[*] Latin-American Spanish
[*] Fixed input on Mac in driving levels
[*] Fixed force feedback option in diving levels
[/list]

[code]NOTE: On first run, the game will open using the same resolution of desktop: if you encounter any performance problems, please set a lower resolution from OPTIONS/VIDEO game menu.[/code]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.92
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31415445/7b3f00e2bfcc4bddeef4804beaf9161cc10fba40.png[/img]
[h1] PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Checkpoints (two each level in easy mode, one in normal difficulty usually before bossfight, none in difficult mode)
[*]Added Gamepad vibration on/off in options menu
[*]Fixed bug that caused Player 2 to activate instead of the CPU in some configurations
[*]Fixed audio issues and crashes on Bud’s shove attack
[*]Adapted the impcact of Bud’s shove and Terence’s kick attack. Still too powerful vs bosses, this will be fixed in next version.
[*]Fixed blocking bugs on fair level boss area
[*]Updated English language
[*]Updated backer’s names in Credits
[/list]
[b]NOTES:[/b] 
You can fast forward the cutscenes by holding down the key used to grab (we will add hints with the button in the next updates)
Please don’t use the “Input” menu on game launch! This menu will be removed in the next version
In the next update we will add complete support to a large amount of PC gamepads that are not recognized at the moment
